settings.text: 6. Dual-Mode Brushing for Sensitive Teeth and Gums

settings.repere: Paragraphe · As we age, our teeth and gums can become
settings.text: As we age, our teeth and gums can become more sensitive. That’s why the UMMA Diamond Sonic Toothbrush was designed with your comfort in mind, offering both Super Clean and Sensitive modes to help ease you into using sonic technology for the first time!

settings.repere: Paragraphe · The Sensitive mode and soft brush bristl
settings.text: The Sensitive mode and soft brush bristles are perfect for those with delicate gums or autoimmune conditions like Sjögren's syndrome. And when you need a deeper clean, Super Clean mode massages your gums whilst being tough on plaque.
